name: Geothermal Terraces
desc: A hillside of geothermal terraces stepping up into haze — cream travertine shelves hold scalloped hot pools ringed with orange and green microbial colour, steam pours off every pool and drifts up across the ranks, the water shivers with vent shimmer and bubbles rise at the sources; white travertine, a soft pink-gold dawn, an eerie moonlit night, thermal false-colour with the pools as hot cores, or sumi ink.

energy.doc: how hard the light works — steam brightness, pool shimmer, bubble glints

scale.doc: how large the terraces are — shelf and pool size (rebuilds the terraces)

density.doc: how many terrace bands, rimstone scallops and steam plumes

speed.doc: steam rise, pool shimmer and bubble rate

steam.doc: how much steam pours off the pools

heat.doc: how hot the springs read — intensity of the microbial colour rings

hue.doc: palette hue shift off the default teal pools

x.doc: which way the terraces and light bias across the frame

y.doc: the horizon line — low y gives more terraces, high y more sky

style.doc: aesthetic: travertine = white-cream mineral shelves, teal pools, warm microbial rims; dawn = soft pink-gold steam, cool pools; nocturne = eerie moonlit night, deep blue pools; thermal = false-colour ironbow with pools as hot cores; ink = sumi tonal terraces and steam wash

act.doc: multi-minute programme — steady venting, steam surges building and easing over sections, or a cooling with less steam and calmer pools

seed.doc: regenerates the terrace placement, pools, rimstone and steam

alpha.doc: how far the world sits back behind the performers
